forecast_origin.description: Last month in the input history (YYYY-MM).

history_start.description: First month of the history window.

history_length.description: Number of history months (6 in the paper).

horizons.description: JSON array of forecast horizons, e.g. [1, 2, 3].

feature_columns.description: JSON array naming the columns of history_feature_matrix.

type_count_columns.description: JSON array naming offense-type count columns.

history_total_case_count_seq.description: JSON array of monthly counts, length history_length.

history_feature_matrix.description: JSON array with shape history_length x n_features.

history_type_ratio_seq.description: JSON array with shape history_length x n_types.

target_total_case_count_seq.description: JSON array of counts for each horizon.

target_type_count_h1.description: JSON array of type counts at horizon 1.

target_type_ratio_h1.description: JSON array of type ratios at horizon 1.

dominant_type_h1.description: Most frequent offense type at horizon 1.
